hints.content:
###Strategy

Let's use the data in the graph to find how much range is gained from $1$ minute of charging. Then, we can write an equation to find how much charging time ($t$) it takes to gain any number of kilometers in range ($k$).

###Unit rate and equation

[[☃ image 1]]

$t$ | $1$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div10}$ | $10$ | $20$ | $30$
:- | -: | -: | -: | -: | -:
$k$ | $15$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div10}$ | $150$ | $300$ | $450$

The electric car gains $15\,\text{km}$ of range for every $1$ minute of charging, so we can write an equation to find how many kilometers of range the car gains ($k$) for any number of minutes it charges ($t$):

$k=15t$

And we can rewrite the equation so time ($t$) is by itself:

$t=\dfrac{k}{15}$
